messages:
maya (PM): Heads-up: proposing a staged launch for Optimize Toolkit — splitting into three wedges: A) batching + prefix caching advisor, B) quantization recommendation engine (safe defaults + rollback), C) eval-triggered alerting. Each wedge should have its own acceptance criteria and pilot customers. Want to align on gating and minimal API surface. Thoughts?
ci-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/optimize/staged-wedges-proposal (editable) :sparkles:
derek (Eng): Agree on wedges. Need concrete perf targets for A/B. Suggest A: p95 latency regression <5% and cost reduction >=15% on workload X. Also need example API: `POST /optimize/assess` with body `{model, workload_profile}`.
anika (SRE): Telemetry/SLIs: we'll need batch size distribution, cache hit rate, KV cache evictions, and end-to-end p99. For canary, propose 5% traffic for 48h, then 25% for 72h. Alerts: auto rollback if p99 increases >20% or error rate >0.5%.
samir (CS): From field: customers want a "show me savings" report and a non-invasive opt-in pilot. Pilot candidates: AcmeHealth, LexiDocs, SummitChat. They care about data residency for Private deployments and explicit consent for offline profiling.
derek (Eng): Implementation note: for quant recs, start with offline scoring + UI flags. Runtime fallback should be annotated model variants. Plan for `--force-fp16` and `--quant-profile=medium` toggles.
maya (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal for wedge A (batch+cache): 1) 3 pilot customers onboarded, 2) measured median cost savings >=12% across pilots, 3) no customer-facing errors introduced, 4) docs + SDK sample. Wedge B: safe-default quant profile with rollback and perf benchmark. Wedge C: eval-rule templates + oncall runbook and playbook.
anika (SRE): :thumbsup: add telemetry retention 90d for pilot. Also need burn-in tests for hybrid workloads (short chat + long completion). Will require synthetic harness and smoke tests.
samir (CS): I'll start outreach to the pilots this week. Ask: can we provide a quick 'savings estimate' doc for them? If so, send me the template I can use in outreach.
derek (Eng): I'll drop a PR with the API proto and a small CLI to generate a savings estimate. Example command: `rio estimate --model redwood-3b --qprofile medium --workload sample.json` — will attach sample workloads.
maya (PM): Great. Timeline suggestion: A (4 weeks), B (6 weeks after A), C (4 weeks after B). Can we commit to those sprints? If not, propose alternatives.
anika (SRE): Feasible but we need a stabilization buffer after A (1 sprint). Recommend A: 5w with buffer.
maya (PM): Noted. I'll update the roadmap doc and put a decision due date: next Wed. cc @derek, @anika, @samir. Thanks!
